BETWEEN:-
 RAJA @ KARAN SILAVAT S/O KISHOR LAL, AGED  ABOUT 21 YEARS, OCCUPATION: STUDENT R/O NEW  BAJRANG WARD POLICE STATION AND TEHSIL  GOTEGAON DISTRICT NARSINGHPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI PARITOSH TRIVEDI - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BANKHEDI DISTRICT NARMADAPURAM  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ATMARAM BEN - DEPUTY GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 (SHRI SANDEEP KACHHI - ADVOCATE FOR THE OBJECTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.233/2023, dated 01.07.2023, registered at Police Station Bankhedi,
District Narmadapuram (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 368,
506 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text:
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant - Raja @ Karan Silavat is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

District Narmadapuram (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 368,
506 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
Applicant is in detention since 08.07.2023.
